messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — router latency surge in eu-west-1. p95 ~ 800ms, p99 ~ 4.3s, streaming stalls observed. Runbook: https://runbook.local/router-tail-surge :rotating_light:

alice: ack. I'm oncall. standing up tail-sample and tracing, assigning to raj. I'll update

raj: diving in. I already see a config rollout ~00:30 ago: route-affinity-v2 enabled with stronger region preference. correlates with p99 jump. pulling router-change logs...

raj: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z router-config apply route-affinity-v2 weight=0.8 region=eu-west-1 change_id=chg-8921
2026-03-15T09:12:45Z router-shard[17] queue_depth=120 avg_lat=450ms
```

maria: infra metrics show shard-17 queue_depth spike and high CPU on lb-proxy-eu-2. per-shard queueing causing tail stalls on streaming sessions.

sam-devex: CS alert — two customers reported streaming stalls and partial 502 spikes ~09:20-09:36. adding them to impact list.

alice: mitigation proposal: rollback route-affinity-v2 to previous config (weight back to 0.2), enable fallback to global-pool for long-lived streams, and temporarily cap shard max_inflight to 80. if rollback not safe, we can set per-region weights to distribute load. I'll execute rollback now.

raj: running rollback:
```
routerctl config set route-affinity-v2.weight 0.2 --change=rollback-chg-8921
routerctl service set eu-west-1.fallback_policy global_pool
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by alice — change_id=rollback-chg-8921. Canaries: 10% -> 100% across control-plane.

alice: monitoring dashboards. watching p95/p99 and streaming-stall-rate.

maria: p99 dropped from 4.3s -> 650ms within 6m of rollback. queue_depth for shard-17 trending down. CPU on lb-proxy-eu-2 normalized.

sam-devex: CS notified customers with short summary and ETA. preparing post-incident message.

ben: good catch on correlation. follow-ups: add rollout gate to check per-shard queue_depth and max-inflight, require rollouts to target low-load windows. Also write an e2e test for affinity changes under connection pressure.

alice: agreed. action items: (1) postmortem; (2) rollout-gates + telemetry alerts; (3) tweak canary to include region stress test; (4) customer outreach. I'll keep incident open for 30m monitoring hold.

customer-success: we'll coordinate outreach and prioritize customers X and Y. drafting message.

incident-bot: Status update: Mitigation in place. Service impact reduced. Incident severity downgraded. oncall-handoff planned at +30m if stable.

alice: marking resolved after monitoring hold. closing thread once hold complete. thanks all :heart:
